title: Free-energy device in Stan Meyer's archive in Michigan
summary: Steven Greer tells of Free-energy device in Stan Meyer's archive in Michigan, about unspecified at Michigan, US, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So my science advisor Dr. Loader went and saw this warehouse full of floppy disc and devices but he had one thing of great interest.

plain: A UFO researcher named Steven Greer, on Jesse Michels' podcast, says his science adviser, Dr. Ted Loder, visited a warehouse in Michigan holding the archive of the late inventor Stan Meyer, full of floppy disks and devices. Greer says one item there was of great interest, a free-energy device, meaning a machine said to give out more energy than it takes in, and he points to a photo online. If true, it would mean world-changing energy technology is sitting unused.
